sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Inhale, Tactile), Fire Release, Water Release

system.description:
You create a current of steam, expanding and firing it forward like a train barreling forward. All creatures in a 30-foot long, 5-foot-wide line must make a Dexterity saving throw.

Critical Success: Affected creature takes half of 2d10 acid damage.

Success: Affected creature takes half of 2d10 acid damage. This damage ignores temporary hit points and DR a creature has.

Failure: Affected creature takes 2d10 acid damage and also cannot gain bonus DR or Temporary hit points before the beginning of your next turn.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but affected creature takes 4d10 acid damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and damage by 1d10.
